name: Indigenous Regional Innovation Entrepreneurship (IRIE)
eligibilitySummary: Ontario provincial program supporting Indigenous-led businesses and entrepreneurs through grants for business startup, growth, and innovation. Delivered in partnership with Indigenous financial institutions and community organizations.

funding.description: Grants from $5,000 to $100,000 for business startup, expansion, and innovation projects. Can cover equipment, working capital, training, and business planning costs.

requiredDocuments: Proof of Indigenous identity or community affiliation
application.applicationRequirements: Must be an Indigenous entrepreneur or Indigenous-owned business based in Ontario. Must provide proof of Indigenous identity (First Nations, Metis, or Inuit). Business must be registered in Ontario.
